targets.query: from(bucket: "rpi") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu" and r.cpu == "cpu-total" and r._field == "usage_idle") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: 100.0 - r._value })) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

from(bucket: "rpi") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mem" and r._field == "used") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

from(bucket: "rpi") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "swap" and r._field == "used") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

from(bucket: "rpi") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_mem" and r._field == "usage" and r.container_name == "languagetool") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

from(bucket: "rpi") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_cpu" and r._field == "usage_percent" and r.container_name == "languagetool") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

options.content:
**Per-container swap isn't exposed** by Docker/cgroup through the metrics agent, so LanguageTool's *own* swap can't be graphed directly.

In practice it's ~0: LanguageTool is capped (`mem_limit` 1.25 GB) and runs under that, so it barely swaps itself. The **Used swap — overall** panel captures the real swap pressure on the Pi.
